instrument: Indianapolis data center moratorium (City-County Council and Metropolitan Development Commission)
summary: A moratorium on new data center approvals running through December 31, 2027. Three approved projects proceed. The Department of Metropolitan Development is to retain a consultant and seat an Advisory Committee to draft standards.
notes: CONFLICT on the instrument: one account records a 6-0 Metropolitan Development Commission approval; another records the pause becoming binding by a 23-1 City-County Council vote on August 10, 2026, ratified by the MDC on August 19. Exempt projects are described variously as Decatur Township, Martindale-Brightwood and the former Ford Visteon site on Fintail Drive, and as DC Blox, Metrobloks and Sabey. Same pause, unreconciled instrument and vote. Indiana context per IU Environmental Resilience Institute: 11 counties with ordinances, at least 17 moratoria, 2 bans (Marshall, Cass).
confidence_note: Both accounts relayed; neither the council proposal nor the MDC record has been read. Resolve before citing the vote.

source.citation: Fox59; datacenterbans.com; IPR/WBOI citing IU ERI
